scripts.build: npm run build:issue-triage && npm run build:draft-pr
scripts.build:check: issue_bundle_tmp=$(mktemp) && draft_bundle_tmp=$(mktemp) && esbuild src/issue-triage/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=$issue_bundle_tmp >/dev/null && esbuild src/draft-pr/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=$draft_bundle_tmp >/dev/null && node scripts/normalize-generated.mjs $issue_bundle_tmp $draft_bundle_tmp && cmp -s $issue_bundle_tmp agents/issue-triage/scripts/issue-triage.mjs && cmp -s $draft_bundle_tmp agents/draft-pr/scripts/draft-pr.mjs; build_check_status=$?; rm -f $issue_bundle_tmp $draft_bundle_tmp; exit $build_check_status
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:check
